title: MYKAH - All Gas No Breaks
htmlContent:
MYKAH brings a sound that will have you walking on clouds on the new song “All Gas No Breaks”. The record is intriguing before you hit play, with a unique artist name and stand out title to make you want to see what the music is all about. As soon as you hit play you’re hooked with a creative abstract sound takes you away, to enjoy her vocals to the fullest that melt you with every note, to make a record that feels so good to hear you’ll be coming back for more instantly.

The song "All Gas No Breaks" is everything music is about and why people fall in love with music. It connects to you and gives you that more we seek when hearing music. This song is beyond words and makes you want to keep running back for this experience of music.
